style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This decorative bow ornament is designed for quick and stylish Christmas decorating on trees, wreaths, garlands, and door handles. The classic bow shape in soft velvet instantly adds a warm, festive accent, while fine silver glitter gives a subtle sparkle under Christmas lights. Lightly filled for a plush look, it keeps its shape throughout the season. The attached red ribbon hanger makes installation easy on almost any branch or hook, ideal for fast decorating in living rooms, hallways, or offices. Supplied in assorted oxblood and Christmas red colours for varied, rich seasonal styling. Shape: stuffed velvet bow ornament with long tails. Dimensions: approx. 14 cm height, 11 cm width, 2 cm depth. Material: 90% polyester, 10% cotton velvet with filling. Finish: multi red tones with silver mirror glitters, indoor use. Easy to hang with integrated red ribbon loop.
